prompt: Composition: Narrow index beside an unframed detail pane; index becomes a menu on mobile. Build for this brief: A public information service; people find reliable guidance quickly. Set headings in Oswald and reading text in Work Sans; condensed heading with open sans text. Use Plum and Mint: page #FCF9FF, text #3D2346, accent #805099, secondary surface #CDF3DF, text on accent #FFFFFF. Use body 16px, heading 64px, line height 1.45, reading measure at most 56ch, gap 16px, content width at most 1120px and item radius 2px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
